name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
summary: Income support for qualifying landholding farmer families, subject to exclusions and government verification.

rules.label: No PM-KISAN exclusion applies to the family

limitations: Self-reported land and exclusions cannot establish official eligibility. Government land records, family definition, date of land acquisition, state exceptions and registration must be checked with the official portal.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
benefit: Central contribution: ₹200 monthly ages 60–79, ₹500 monthly from age 80; state top-ups vary
summary: NSAP old-age pension for a person aged 60 or over in a BPL household.

rules.label: Household is BPL under the official list/criteria

limitations: Income amount by itself does not prove BPL status. Government/local authority must verify BPL record and application.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
benefit: Central contribution: ₹300 monthly (state additions may vary)
summary: NSAP pension for BPL widows aged 40–59.

rules.label: Household is BPL under official criteria

limitations: Government/local authority must verify widow and BPL status; this tool cannot determine official entitlement.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
benefit: Central contribution: ₹300 monthly (state additions may vary)
summary: NSAP pension for BPL people aged 18–59 with severe or multiple disabilities.

rules.label: Household is BPL under official criteria

limitations: Government/local authority must verify disability classification and BPL status; this tool cannot determine official entitlement.
